{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DataKinds #-}
{-# LANGUAGE TypeFamilies #-}

module TemplateService where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe, isJust)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum)

-- Role definitions
data Role = Admin | Editor | Viewer deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data User = User
  { userName :: Text
  , userRole :: Role
  , userOrg  :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- Template store
data Template = Template
  { tmplName    :: Text
  , tmplBody    :: Text
  , tmplOwner   :: Text
  , tmplPublic  :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

-- Global state (simulating gRPC service state)
{-# NOINLINE templateStore #-}
templateStore :: IORef (Map Text Template)
templateStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

{-# NOINLINE userStore #-}
userStore :: IORef (Map Text User)
userStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef $ Map.fromList
  [ ("admin", User "admin" Admin "system")
  , ("editor1", User "editor1" Editor "orgA")
  , ("viewer1", User "viewer1" Viewer "orgA")
  ]

-- Template expression evaluator (restricted subset)
data Expr = Literal Text | Variable Text | Concat Expr Expr | FuncCall Text [Expr]
  deriving (Show)

-- Parse a simple template expression language
parseExpr :: Text -> Either Text Expr
parseExpr input
  | T.null input = Right (Literal "")
  | T.isPrefixOf "{{" input =
      let rest = T.drop 2 input
          (expr, remaining) = T.breakOn "}}" rest
      in if T.null remaining
         then Left "Unclosed expression"
         else case parseInner (T.strip expr) of
           Right e -> case parseExpr (T.drop 2 remaining) of
             Right next -> Right (Concat e next)
             Left err -> Left err
           Left err -> Left err
  | otherwise =
      let (lit, rest) = T.breakOn "{{" input
      in case parseExpr rest of
        Right next -> Right (Concat (Literal lit) next)
        Left err -> Left err

parseInner :: Text -> Either Text Expr
parseInner t
  | T.isPrefixOf "call:" t = parseFuncCall (T.drop 5 t)
  | T.all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '_' || c == '.') t = Right (Variable t)
  | otherwise = Right (Literal t)

parseFuncCall :: Text -> Either Text Expr
parseFuncCall t =
  let (fname, argsRaw) = T.breakOn "(" t
      args = T.drop 1 $ T.dropEnd 1 argsRaw
      argList = map (Right . Variable . T.strip) $ T.splitOn "," args
  in Right $ FuncCall fname (map (\(Right x) -> x) argList)

-- Safe functions allowed in templates
safeFunctions :: Map Text ([Text] -> Text)
safeFunctions = Map.fromList
  [ ("upper", \args -> T.toUpper (head args))
  , ("lower", \args -> T.toLower (head args))
  , ("length", \args -> T.pack . show . T.length $ head args)
  , ("concat", \args -> T.concat args)
  ]

-- Context for template evaluation
type EvalContext = Map Text Text

-- Evaluate expression with context
evalExpr :: EvalContext -> Expr -> Either Text Text
evalExpr ctx (Literal t) = Right t
evalExpr ctx (Variable v) = Right $ fromMaybe "" (Map.lookup v ctx)
evalExpr ctx (Concat a b) = do
  ra <- evalExpr ctx a
  rb <- evalExpr ctx b
  Right (ra <> rb)
evalExpr ctx (FuncCall name args) = do
  evaluatedArgs <- mapM (evalExpr ctx) args
  case Map.lookup name safeFunctions of
    Just f -> Right (f evaluatedArgs)
    Nothing -> Left $ "Unknown function: " <> name

-- Access control check
canAccess :: User -> Template -> Bool
canAccess user tmpl
  | userRole user == Admin = True
  | tmplPublic tmpl = True
  | userOrg user == tmplOwner tmpl = True
  | otherwise = False

canModify :: User -> Template -> Bool
canModify user tmpl
  | userRole user == Admin = True
  | userRole user == Editor && userOrg user == tmplOwner tmpl = True
  | otherwise = False

-- Template rendering pipeline
data RenderRequest = RenderRequest
  { reqUser     :: Text
  , reqTemplate :: Text
  , reqContext  :: Map Text Text
  , reqPartials :: Map Text Text  -- inline partial templates (pre-validated)
  }

-- The rendering pipeline processes partials by inlining them as LITERALS only
resolvePartials :: Text -> Map Text Text -> Text
resolvePartials body partials =
  Map.foldlWithKey' (\acc name partial -> 
    T.replace ("{{> " <> name <> "}}") (escapeForLiteral partial) acc
  ) body partials

-- Escape partial content so it cannot introduce new template expressions
escapeForLiteral :: Text -> Text
escapeForLiteral = T.replace "{{" "\\{\\{" . T.replace "}}" "\\}\\}"

-- Main render function
renderTemplate :: RenderRequest -> IO (Either Text Text)
renderTemplate req = do
  users <- readIORef userStore
  templates <- readIORef templateStore
  case Map.lookup (reqUser req) users of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    Just user -> case Map.lookup (reqTemplate req) templates of
      Nothing -> return $ Left "Template not found"
      Just tmpl ->
        if not (canAccess user tmpl)
          then return $ Left "Access denied"
          else do
            -- Resolve partials into the template body (escaped)
            let resolved = resolvePartials (tmplBody tmpl) (reqPartials req)
            -- Parse and evaluate
            case parseExpr resolved of
              Left err -> return $ Left $ "Parse error: " <> err
              Right expr -> return $ evalExpr (reqContext req) expr

-- Store a template (with RBAC)
storeTemplate :: Text -> Text -> Text -> Bool -> IO (Either Text ())
storeTemplate userId name body isPublic = do
  users <- readIORef userStore
  case Map.lookup userId users of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    Just user ->
      if userRole user == Viewer
        then return $ Left "Insufficient permissions"
        else do
          let tmpl = Template name body (userOrg user) isPublic
          modifyIORef' templateStore (Map.insert name tmpl)
          return $ Right ()

-- Admin-only: evaluate raw expression (for debugging)
adminEval :: Text -> Text -> Map Text Text -> IO (Either Text Text)
adminEval userId rawExpr ctx = do
  users <- readIORef userStore
  case Map.lookup userId users of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Authentication failed"
    Just user -> do
      if userRole user /= Admin
        then return $ Left "Admin only"
        else case parseExpr rawExpr of
          Left err -> return $ Left err
          Right expr -> return $ evalExpr ctx expr

-- Batch render: renders multiple templates, merging contexts
-- This is used for report generation
batchRender :: Text -> [(Text, Map Text Text, Map Text Text)] -> IO [Either Text Text]
batchRender userId items = do
  users <- readIORef userStore
  case Map.lookup userId users of
    Nothing -> return [Left "Authentication failed"]
    Just user -> mapM (\(tmplName, ctx, partials) -> 
      renderTemplate (RenderRequest userId tmplName ctx partials)
      ) items
